zh: 『她说∶算了，算了。我们老爷说，现在市面上银根紧，阜康只怕要紧要慢的时候，没有现银，不如存到外国银行。现在听人你这样子说，我倒不好意思了。还是存在你们这里好了。螺蛳太太，我当时悟出一个诀窍，我们这块金字招牌，要用外国货的擦铜油来擦。啥叫外国货的擦铜油，就是跟外国银行往来，我要到所有外国银行去开户头，象遇到周家五姨太那种来提存的户头，我问她要哪家外国银行的票子，说哪家就是哪家；这一下阜康的招牌不是更响了。』螺蛳太太因为他的话中听，所以能够深入，这时听出来一个疑问∶『法子是蛮好，不过这一来不是有大笔头寸搁在那里了？』『哪里，哪里！』宓本常乱摇着双手，『那样做法不是太笨了？』『不笨怎么办？』『这里头又有诀窍了。每家银行开个户头，存个三两千银子；等开出票子，我先一步把头寸调足送进去，就不会穿帮了。』『来得及吗？』
en: “She said, ‘Never mind, then. My husband says money is tight and Fukang might not have ready silver when we urgently need it, so a foreign bank would be safer. But after what you have said, I feel rather ashamed. I shall leave it with you.’ Madam Luosi, that taught me a trick. We must polish our golden signboard with foreign metal polish. What is that polish? Dealings with foreign banks. I mean to open an account with every one of them. If a customer like Intendant Zhou’s fifth concubine comes to withdraw money, I shall ask which foreign bank’s draft she wants. Whichever she names, she shall have it. Would that not make Fukang’s name more impressive still?” Madam Luosi found his argument persuasive and followed it closely. Now a question occurred to her. “A fine method, but would it not leave large sums lying idle in those banks?” Mi waved both hands. “No, no! That would be foolish.” “What is the clever way, then?” “There is another trick. Open an account at each bank and deposit two or three thousand taels. When a draft is issued, I arrange to send in enough funds before it is presented, and nothing goes wrong.” “Can you do it in time?”

zh: 『来得及，来得及。喏，这就是德律风根的好处，拿起话筒摇过去，说有这么一回事，那里的行员，自会替我们应付。』螺蛳太太听他的谈论，学到很多东西；中国钱庄经营的要诀，她听胡雪岩谈过几回，并不外行，但外国银行的情形，却不知其详，这时听宓本常说得头头是道，遇事留心的她，自然不肯放弃机会，所以接上来便问，是如何应付？人家又为什么会替阜康应付？『应付的法子多得很，不过万变不离其宗，就是拖一拖辰光，等我们把头寸调齐补足。』『万一调不齐呢。』『不错，不怕一万，只怕万一。这种情形，从来没有过，不过不能不防。说到这上头，就靠平常的交际，外国银行的「康白度」，我都有交情的；那班「洋行小鬼」，平时也要常常应酬，所以万一遇到头寸调不齐，只要我通知一声，他们会替我代垫。这是事先说好了的，代垫照算拆息，日子最多三天。』宓本常特为又重复一句∶『不过，这种情形从来没有过。』『喔，』螺蛳太太又问∶『我们跟哪几家外国银行有往来？』统统有。『
en: “Certainly. That is where the telephone comes in. Lift the receiver, ring them up, and explain. Their staff will find a way to accommodate us.” Madam Luosi was learning a great deal. Hu had explained the essentials of Chinese banking several times, so she was no novice; foreign banks, however, were less familiar. Hearing Mi speak so confidently, she would not miss the chance to learn. How did the staff accommodate Fukang, and why should they do so? “There are many ways, but the principle is always the same: gain a little time until we have assembled and supplied the funds.” “What if you cannot?” “Exactly. However unlikely, the worst possibility must be allowed for. It has never happened, but we must be prepared. Then we depend on ordinary social connections. I know all the foreign banks’ compradors and regularly entertain their junior Chinese clerks too. If ever I cannot assemble the money, I need only send word and they will advance it. That is agreed beforehand. We pay the usual short-term interest, and the advance may last no more than three days.” He repeated emphatically, “But it has never happened.” “Which foreign banks do we deal with?” she asked. “All of them.”

zh: 接下来，宓本常便屈指细数。上海的外国银行，最有名的是英文名称叫做『香港上海银行有限公司』的汇丰银行，但最老的却是有利银行，咸丰四年便已开办；不过后来居上的却是麦加利银行，这家银行的英文名称叫做∶Ｃｈａｒｔｅｒｃｄ－ＢａｎｋｏｆＩｎｄｉａ，ＡｕｓｔｒａｌｉａａｎｄＣｈｉｎａ。但香港分行与上海分行的译名不同，香港照音译，称为渣打银行；上海的银钱业嫌它叫起来不响，而且顾名不能思义，所以用他总经理麦加利的名字，称之为麦加利银行。『麦加利是英国女皇下圣旨设立的，不过这家银行是专门为了英国人在印度、澳洲同我们中国经商所开的，重在存放款跟汇兑，纯然是商业银行，跟汇丰银行带点官派的味道不大一样。』宓本常又说∶『自从左大人到两京，大先生亦不经手偿洋债了，我们阜康跟汇丰的关系就淡了。所以我现在是向麦加利下工夫。这一点顺便拜托罗四太太告诉大先生。』『好的，我晓得了。』螺蛳太太对宓本常的长袖善舞，印象颇为深刻；观感当然也改变了，觉得他是为了本身的职司，要对得起老板，就免不了得罪朋友。不过，自己是在古应春面前夸下海口，要来替他出气。如今搞成个虎头蛇尾，似乎愧对古应春。
en: Mi began counting them off. Shanghai’s best-known foreign bank was HSBC, whose English name was the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Company Limited. The oldest, however, was the Mercantile Bank, opened in the fourth year of Xianfeng. The Chartered Bank had come later but overtaken its rivals. Its full English name was the Chartered Bank of India, Australia and China. Its Hong Kong and Shanghai branches nevertheless had different Chinese names. Hong Kong used the phonetic “Zhada,” while Shanghai bankers considered that insufficiently resonant and uninformative. They called it Maijiali, after its manager. “It was established by a royal charter from the British queen. But it exists specifically to serve British trade in India, Australia, and China. Its main business is deposits, loans, and remittances—a purely commercial bank, unlike HSBC, which has something of an official air. Since His Excellency Zuo came to Liangjiang, Mr Hu no longer handles foreign-debt repayments, and Fukang’s connection with HSBC has weakened. I am now concentrating on the Chartered Bank. Please mention that to Mr Hu, Madam Luo.” “I shall.” Mi’s skill in managing his connections impressed her and changed her opinion. In fulfilling his duties and serving his employer, he could hardly avoid offending friends. Yet she had promised Gu that she would obtain satisfaction for him. To begin boldly and end feebly would seem a betrayal.

zh: 这样转着念头，脸上自不免流露出为难的神气。善于察言观色的宓本常便即问道∶『罗四太太，你是不是有啥话，好象不大肯说，不要紧的，我跟大先生多年，就同晚辈一样；罗四太太，你是长辈，如果我有啥不对，请你尽管说！我是、我是——掉句书袋，叫做「有则改之，无则加勉」。』螺蛳太太听他的话很诚恳，觉得稍为透露也不妨，于是很含蓄地说∶『你没有啥不对，大先生把阜康交给你，你当然顾牢阜康，这是天经地义。不过，有时候朋友的事，也要顾一顾，到底大家都是在一条船上的人。』这一下等于是泄了底，螺蛳太太是为了他勒住该付古应春的款子来兴师问罪，当即认错，表示歉意∶『是！是！我对应春，是想到阜康是大先生事业的命脉，处理得稍为过分了一点；其实公是公、私是私！我同他的交情是不会变的。如今请罗四太太说一句我应该怎么样同他赔不是？我一定遵命。』『赔不是的话是严重了。』螺蛳太太忽然灵机一动∶『眼前倒有个能顾全你们交情的机会。』她朝外看了一下，没有再说下去。宓本常稍为想一想，便能领悟，是指古应春纳宠而言。她刚才看一看，是防着瑞香会听见。『我懂了。我来办；好好替他热闹热闹。』
en: Her difficulty showed in her face. Quick to read an expression, Mi asked, “Is there something you hesitate to say? Please do not. After so many years with Mr Hu, I am almost one of the younger generation. You are my elder. If I have done anything wrong, tell me. To borrow a literary phrase, I shall correct any fault I have, and guard against those I have not.” His apparent sincerity persuaded her that a hint could do no harm. “You have done nothing wrong. Mr Hu entrusted Fukang to you; naturally you must protect it. But sometimes you must consider a friend’s affairs too. After all, everyone is in the same boat.” That revealed her purpose: she had come to call him to account for withholding the money due to Gu. He immediately admitted fault and apologized. “Yes. I went a little too far with Yingchun, thinking of Fukang as the lifeblood of Mr Hu’s business. But public business and private friendship are separate; my feelings for him have not changed. Tell me how I ought to make amends, and I shall obey.” “Making amends is too strong a phrase.” An idea struck her. “There is an opportunity now to preserve your friendship.” She glanced outside and left the thought unfinished. Mi understood after a moment: Gu’s taking a concubine. She had looked out to make sure Ruixiang could not hear. “I understand. I shall take charge and give him a proper celebration.”

zh: 说送一份重礼，不足为奇；如果是宓本常自告奋勇来为古应春办这场喜事，费心费力，才显得出朋友的交情。螺蛳太太非常满意，但怕他是敷衍面子，不能不敲钉转脚加一句∶『宓先生，这是你自己说的噢！』『罗四太太请放心，完全交给我，一定办得很风光。』宓本常接着很郑重地表示∶『不过，公是公，私是私。我刚才同罗四太太谈的各样情形，千万不必同应春去讲。』『我晓得。』宓本常一面应酬螺蛳太太，一面心里在转念头。原来他也有一番雄心壮志，看胡雪岩这么一片『鲜花着锦』的事业，不免兴起『大丈夫不当如是耶』的想法，觉得虽蒙重用，毕竟是做伙计，自己也应该创一番事业。此念起于五年以前，但直到前年年底，方成事实。
en: An expensive gift alone would be unremarkable. Mi’s volunteering to organize the occasion, giving his own time and effort, would demonstrate real friendship. Madam Luosi was delighted, though she feared mere polite evasion and therefore pinned him down. “Remember, Mr Mi, that was your own offer.” “Do not worry. Leave everything to me. I shall make it splendid.” He added gravely, “But business and private matters must remain separate. There is no need to tell Yingchun anything of what I have explained today.” “I understand.” While entertaining her, Mi was turning over plans of his own. He too had ambitions. Looking at Hu’s dazzling success, he could not help thinking that a man ought to achieve as much himself. However trusted, he remained an employee. He should build a business of his own. The idea had first occurred five years earlier, but only at the end of the year before last had it taken shape.

zh: 原来他有个嫡亲的表弟叫陈义生，一向跟沙船帮做南北货生意，那年押货到北方，船上出事，一根桅杆忽然折断，砸伤了他的腿，得了残疾；东家送他两千银子，请他回宁波原籍休养；宓本常回家过年，经常在一起盘桓，大年三十夜里谈了一个通宵，谈出结果来了。宓本常是盘算过多少遍的，如果跟胡雪岩明言，自己想创业，胡雪岩也会帮他的忙，但一定是小规模重头做起，而又必须辞掉阜康的职务。不做大寺庙的知客，去做一个不茅庵的住持，不是聪明的办法——他认为最聪明的办法是，利用在阜康的地位，调度他人的资本，去做自己的生意；但决不能做钱庄，也不能做丝茧，因为这跟『老板』的事业是犯冲突的。他的难题是∶第一，不知道哪种生意加收得快？因为要调集三、五十万，他力量是够得到，只是临时周转，周而复始，看不出他在挪用公款，期限一长，少不得要露马脚。其次，他不能出面；一出面人家就会打听，他的资本来自何处，更怕胡雪岩说一句∶『创业维艰，一定要专心，你不能再替我做档手了。不然「驼子跌跟斗，两头落空」，耽误了你自己，也耽误了我。』那一来，什么都无从谈起了。这两个难题，遇到陈义生迎刃而解。他说∶『要讲回收得快，莫如南北货；货色都是须先定好的，先收定洋，货到照算。南货销北，北货销南，一趟船做两笔生意；只要两三个来回，本常哥，你马上就是大老板了。』『看你讲得这么好，为啥我的朋友当中，做这行生意的，简直找不出来？』
en: His younger cousin, Chen Yisheng, had long worked with the coastal junk merchants in the trade between north and south. While accompanying a shipment north that year, he had been injured when a mast suddenly snapped and struck his leg. Left disabled, he received two thousand taels from his employer and was sent home to Ningbo to recuperate. Mi returned there for the New Year and spent much time with him. On New Year’s Eve, they talked through the night and reached a conclusion. Mi had considered his position repeatedly. If he told Hu that he wanted a business of his own, Hu would help him, but he would have to begin on a small scale and resign from Fukang. To leave the position of guest-master at a great monastery for the abbacy of a tiny thatched hermitage was hardly wise. The clever course, he believed, was to use his position at Fukang to deploy other people’s capital in his own enterprise. It must not be banking or silk and cocoons, however, since those would compete with his employer. There were two difficulties. First, what business would return its capital quickly? He could mobilize three to five hundred thousand taels, but only temporarily. Repeated short turns of the money might conceal his misuse of entrusted funds; a long commitment would expose him. Second, he could not appear openly. People would inquire into the source of his capital; worse, Hu might say, “Building a business takes concentration. You cannot remain my head clerk. Otherwise you will fall between two stools, harming both your affairs and mine.” Then the whole scheme would collapse. Chen solved both problems. “For a quick return of capital, nothing beats the north-south trade. Orders are placed beforehand and deposits collected; the balance is settled when the goods arrive. Southern goods go north, northern goods south—two transactions on one voyage. After two or three return trips, Brother Benchang, you will be a great merchant.” “If it is so good, why can I scarcely find anyone among my acquaintances in that line?”

zh: 『不是找不出来，是你不晓得而已。』陈义生说∶『做这行生意，吃本很重，不是一般人能做的。至于真正有钱想做这行生意的。又吃不起辛苦。做南北货生意，如果不是内行，不懂行情，也不会看货，哪怕亲自下手押船，也一定让人家吃掉。所以有钱的人，都是放帐叫人家去做，只要不出险，永远都是赚的。』『对了，汪洋大海出了事，船沉了，货色也送了海龙王了，那时候怎么办？』『就是这个风险。不过现在有保险公司也很稳当。』『从前没有保险呢？』『』没有保险，一样也要做。十趟里面不见得出一趟事，就算出一趟事，有那几趟的赚头，也抵得过这一趟的亏蚀。『听得这一说，宓本常大为动心，』义生，『他说，』可惜你的脚跛了。『』我的脚是跛了。『陈义生敲敲自己的头，』我的脑子没有坏。而且伤养好了，至多行动不太方便，又不是病倒在床起不来。『宓本常心想，如果让陈义生出面，由于他本来就干这一行，背后原有好些有钱的人撑腰，资本的来源决没有人会知道。就怕他起黑心，因而沉默不语。
en: “It is not that there are none; you simply do not know about them. The trade requires substantial capital, beyond most people’s reach. Those with enough money are often unwilling to bear the hardship. Without experience, knowledge of prices, and the ability to judge goods, even a man escorting his own cargo will be taken advantage of. Wealthy people therefore advance money for others to trade with. Unless disaster strikes, there is always a profit.” “Exactly. Suppose something happens at sea and the ship sinks, giving its cargo to the Dragon King. What then?” “That is the risk. But with insurance companies now, matters are quite secure.” “What did people do before insurance?” “Traded all the same. Not one voyage in ten necessarily ends in disaster. Even if one does, the profits from the others cover the loss.” Mi was greatly tempted. “A pity about your lame leg, Yisheng.” “My leg is lame.” Chen tapped his head. “My mind is not. Besides, the injury has healed; at worst, moving about is a little inconvenient. I am not confined to bed.” Mi considered. Chen already knew the trade and had long had wealthy backers. With him acting openly, nobody would know where the capital came from. Mi feared only that he might turn dishonest, and remained silent.

zh: 陈义生的娘是宓本常的姑母，，很想乘此机会跟他合作，一个发大财，一个发小财；见此光景，不免失望。但他有他的办法，将他的老娘搬请了出来。陈义生当然也看出宓本常的心意，年初四那天，将宓本常请了去说∶『阿常，你同义生是一起长大的，你两岁死娘，还吃过我的奶，这样子象同胞手足的表兄弟，你为啥有话不肯同义生说？』宓本常当然不能承认，否则不但伤感情，而且以后合作的路子也断了，所以假托了一个理由。『我不是不肯同义生说，钱不是我的，我总要好好儿想一想；等想妥当了再来谈。』『我懂你的意思，你是怕风险。风险无非第一，路上不顺利；第二，怕义生对不起你。如果是怕路上出事，那就不必谈；至于说义生对不起你，那就是对不起我。今天晚上烧「财神纸」，我叫义生在财神菩萨面前赌个咒，明明心迹。『这天晚上到一交子时，便算正月初五，财神菩萨赵玄坛的生日，家家烧财神纸，陈义生奉母之命，在烧纸时立下重誓；然后与宓本常计议，议定一个出钱，一个出力，所得利润，宓本常得两份，陈义生得一份但相约一年内，彼此都不动用盈余，这样才能积累起一笔自己的本钱。
en: Chen, whose mother was Mi’s paternal aunt, very much wanted the partnership: a large fortune for one cousin and a smaller one for the other. Mi’s silence disappointed him, but he had a remedy. He enlisted his mother. She too understood Mi’s concern. On the fourth day of the New Year, she invited him over. “A’chang, you and Yisheng grew up together. Your mother died when you were two; you even drank my milk. You cousins are like brothers. Why will you not speak openly with him?” Mi could hardly acknowledge his suspicion. It would hurt their feelings and close off future cooperation. He invented another reason. “It is not that I will not tell him. The money is not mine. I must think carefully before we discuss it further.” “I understand. You fear the risks. There are only two: an unfortunate voyage, or Yisheng’s failing you. If you fear an accident on the voyage, there is nothing more to say. As for Yisheng, to fail you would be to fail me. Tonight, when we burn offerings to the God of Wealth, I shall have him swear an oath before the deity and make his intentions clear.” At the beginning of the zi hour that evening, it counted as the fifth day of the first month, the birthday of Zhao Xuantan, God of Wealth. Every household burned paper offerings. At his mother’s command, Chen swore a solemn oath during the burning. He and Mi then settled their agreement: one would provide capital, the other work; profits would be divided two shares to Mi and one to Chen. Neither would draw on the profits for a year, allowing them to accumulate capital of their own.

zh: 于是陈义生又到了上海，在十六铺租了房子住下来。等宓本常拨付的五万银子的本钱到手，开始招兵买马，运了一船南货到辽东湾的营口；回程由营口到天津塘沽，装载北货南下，一去一来恰好两个月，结算下来，五万银子的本钱，除去开销、净赚三千，是六分的利息，而宓本常借客户的名义，动支这笔资金，月息只得二厘五，两个月亦不过五厘。宓本常之敌视古应春，就因为自己做了亏心事，怕古应春知道了会告诉胡雪岩，所以不愿他跟阜康过于接近。但现在的想法却大大地一变，主要的是他有了信心，觉得以自己的手腕，很可以表现得大方些；再往深处去想，胡雪岩最信任的就是螺蛳太太与古应春，将这两个人笼络好了，便是立于不败之地，局面愈发得以开展。
en: Chen returned to Shanghai and rented quarters at Shiliupu. Once Mi’s first fifty thousand taels arrived, he recruited his staff and took a shipload of southern goods to Yingkou on Liaodong Bay. Returning, he sailed from Yingkou to Tanggu at Tianjin, loaded northern goods, and brought them south. The round trip took exactly two months. On the fifty thousand taels, the profit after expenses was three thousand—a six-per-cent return. Mi, meanwhile, had drawn the funds in a customer’s name at only a quarter of one per cent a month, or half of one per cent for the two months. His hostility towards Gu sprang from his own misconduct: he feared that Gu would discover it and tell Hu, and therefore wanted to keep him away from Fukang. Now his thinking changed completely. Growing confidence convinced him that he could afford to show generosity. More deeply considered, Hu trusted Madam Luosi and Gu above all others. Winning those two over would make his position impregnable and give his enterprise still greater scope.

zh: 就这一顿饭之间，打定了主意，而且立刻开始实行，自告奋勇带了个伶俐的小徒弟，陪着螺狮太太与瑞香，先到他们宁波同乡开的方九霞银楼去看首饰；然后到抛球场一带的绸缎庄去看衣料。宓本常在十时洋场上也是响当当的人物，奉命唯谨地伺奉在两个堂客左右；不但螺蛳太太觉得面子十足，瑞香的观感亦为之一变——平时听古应春与七姑奶奶谈起宓本常，总说他『面无四两肉』，是个难缠的人物，如今才知道并非如此。到得夕阳西下，该置办的东西都办齐了，帐款都归宓本常结算，首饰随身携带，其余物品，送到阜康钱庄，凭货取款，自有随行的小徒弟去料理。
en: Within the course of that lunch, Mi decided upon the plan and began putting it into practice. Taking a bright young apprentice, he volunteered to accompany Madam Luosi and Ruixiang, first to Fang Jiuxia’s jewellery shop, owned by a fellow Ningbo native, then to the silk shops around the recreation ground. Mi was himself a prominent figure in Shanghai’s foreign settlement. His punctilious attendance upon the two women greatly enhanced Madam Luosi’s dignity and altered Ruixiang’s opinion of him. Whenever Gu and the Seventh Lady mentioned Mi, they spoke of his lean, fleshless face as a sign of a difficult man. Now she found him quite different. By sunset, everything was purchased. Mi would settle all the accounts. They carried the jewellery with them; the other goods were to be delivered to Fukang and paid for on receipt, with the apprentice attending to the details.

zh: 『罗四太太，辰光不早了，我想请你同瑞姑娘到虹口去吃一顿大菜。』宓本常又说∶『今天月底，九月初三好日子，喜事要连夜筹备才来得及；我们一面吃，一面商量。』多谢、多谢。吃大菜是心领了。不过商量办喜事倒是要紧的。我把你这番好意，先同应春说一说，你晚上请到古家来，一切当面谈，好不好？『『好，好！这样也好。』宓本常还是将螺蛳太太与瑞香送回家，只是过门不入而已。
en: “It is getting late, Madam Luo. May I invite you and Miss Rui to a Western dinner in Hongkou? Today is the last day of the month, and the third of the ninth month is the auspicious date. We must prepare the celebration immediately. We can discuss it over dinner.” “Thank you. I appreciate the invitation, but must decline. The arrangements do need discussion, though. Let me first tell Yingchun of your kindness. Come to his house this evening, and we can settle everything face to face.” “Certainly. That will do very well.” Mi escorted the women home, but did not go inside.

zh: 螺蛳太太见了古应春，自然另有一套说法，她先将宓本常是为了『做信用』、『教客户好放心』，才在汇丰存了一笔款子的解释说明白，然后说道∶『他这样做，固然不能算错，不过他对朋友应该讲清楚。这一点，他承认他不对；我也好好说了他一顿。』『这又何必？』『当然要说他。世界上原有一种人，你不说，他不晓得自己错；一说了，他才晓得不但错了，而且大错特错，心里很难过。宓本常就是这样一个人，为了补情认错，他说九月初三的喜事，归他来办；回头他来商量。』螺蛳太太紧接着说∶『姐夫，你亦不必同他客气。我再老实说一句∶他是大先生的伙计，你是大先生的好朋友，要他来当差，也是应该的。』听得这一说，古应春惟有拱手称谢。但也就是刚刚谈完，宓本常已经带着人将为瑞香置办的衣物等等送到；见了古应春，笑容满面地连连拱手。
en: To Gu, Madam Luosi naturally presented matters differently. She first explained that Mi kept money at HSBC to establish Fukang’s credit and reassure its customers. “That is not wrong in itself, but he should explain it to his friends. He admits that fault, and I gave him a proper talking-to.” “There was no need.” “Of course there was. Some people do not know they are wrong until told. Then they realize they were very wrong indeed and feel deeply troubled. Mi is such a man. To make amends, he has offered to organize the celebration on the third. He will come shortly to discuss it.” She added at once, “Do not stand on ceremony. To speak plainly, he is Mr Hu’s employee; you are Mr Hu’s close friend. There is nothing improper in asking him to do the work.” Gu could only clasp his hands in thanks. They had scarcely finished speaking when Mi arrived with men carrying Ruixiang’s new clothes and other purchases. Smiling broadly, he greeted Gu with repeated bows.

zh: 『应春兄，恭喜、恭喜。九月初三，我来效劳；日子太紧，我不敢耽误工夫，今天晚上在府中叨扰，喜事该怎么办？我们一路吃、一路谈，都谈妥当了它；明天一早就动手，尽两天办齐，后天热热闹闹吃喜酒。』见他如此热心，古应春既感动。又困惑——困惑的是，宓本常平时做人，不是这个样子的；莫非真的是内疚于心，刻意补过。心里是这样想，表面上当然也很客气，『老宓，你是个大忙人，为我的事，如此费心，真正不安，不敢当。』他说∶『说实在的，我现在也没有这种闲心思，只为内人催促、罗四太太的盛意，不得不然，只要象个样子，万万不敢铺张。』『不错，总要象个样子。应春兄，你也是上海滩上鼎鼎大名的人物，喜事的场面不可以太俭朴，不然人家背后会批评。
en: “Congratulations, Brother Yingchun! I shall be at your service on the third. With so little time, I dare waste none. Let me impose on your hospitality tonight. We can discuss the arrangements as we eat and settle everything. Tomorrow morning we begin; two days to prepare, and the day after tomorrow we shall have a splendid wedding feast.” Gu was moved but puzzled by such enthusiasm. Mi did not usually behave this way. Was he truly troubled by his conscience and determined to make amends? Whatever his thoughts, Gu responded courteously. “You are a busy man, Mi. I am embarrassed by all this trouble on my account. Frankly, I have little inclination for festivities now. I agreed only because my wife urged me and Madam Luo was so kind. Something respectable will do; I could not presume to be extravagant.” “Certainly—it must be respectable. You are a celebrated man in Shanghai, Brother Yingchun. The occasion must not be too plain, or people will criticize it behind your back.”
